source_coordinates.space: Author-described linear MNI152 coordinates, rounded to published integer millimeters
source_coordinates.unknown: No exact modern MNI152 template filename or content digest is established.
source_coordinates.comparison_scope: Metadata comparison of all 264 published paired coordinates; no affine fitting or image analysis

point_transform.direction: For an input MNI homogeneous point, multiply by the stored printed T matrix to obtain 711 physical coordinates. The named forward t4_pts command internally inverts T for 711-to-MNI points.
point_transform.t4_storage_note: Printed mathematical rows are used directly; no extra transpose or guessed axis flip.

destination.target_template: TRIO_Y_NDC, a representative in 711-2B coordinate space; not asserted identical to the Power 711-2L template
destination.physical_point_bridge: Identity: documented 4dfp physical coordinates are retained while the converter reorders stored spatial indices. No additional point-axis flip is applied.

temporal_metadata.interpretation: Using 2.2 seconds is an explicit acquisition-frame indexing assumption, supported by acquisition metadata and documented index-preserving processing, not a corrected or measured derivative header.
temporal_metadata.exporter_default: The published converter uses 1 second when the IFH fourth scaling factor is zero/absent. The exact historical IFH is unavailable, so this is a possible mechanism, not proven causality.

limits: The exact historical export binary, invocation, IFH and per-subject registration accuracy are not authenticated.
Source metadata and a documented coordinate chain do not establish task outcomes or biological validity.
